_help: days    : '3-6' range | '1,3,5' list | '2-8/2' every other | '4' one day
times   : M=Morning A=Afternoon E=Evening N=Night. Combine: 'M,A' or 'M,A,E,N'
move    : bare pattern name, or {pattern, speed, distance, axis, radius}
requires: 'beaten: NAME' | 'met: NAME' | 'flag: NAME', any prefixed with 'not '.
Compound gates use the longhand object form.
when    : optional rule list, evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM, FIRST MATCH WINS.
A rule states when the character is present plus ONLY what differs.
Anything a rule omits falls back to the character's own value above.
loop    : set false for story characters who must never repeat when the
calendar loops -- they are matched against the real day instead.

says.meet: ...So. Someone finally found the way in. Do not look so surprised — I have been listening to your footsteps since the forest path. I have no interest in your words. Show me your cards instead.
says.repeat: You came back. Then you already know how this ends... or perhaps you don't. Show me again.
says.first_win: ...Enough. You fight better than the ones who built me ever did. Take this — it was here long before the windmill was. Maybe it will mean more to you than it did to me.
says.rematch_win: Again. There is something in you I have not finished measuring.
says.loss: As expected. Strength is not something you can simply walk in and claim. Leave, and come back when you have earned it.
